liblouis 3.39.0, compiled to WebAssembly, and its translation tables.

Everything in this folder is vendored. Do not edit any of it by hand:
tests/test_vendored_liblouis.py checks every file below against the
SHA-256 recorded here and in tables.json.

Engine (liblouis.wasm, liblouis.js)
  Copied byte for byte from openscad-assistive-forge at commit 4355e8a
  (release 5.2.0): public/wasm/liblouis/liblouis.wasm and
  vendor/liblouis/liblouis.mjs, renamed liblouis.js so every server sends it
  as JavaScript. Built there by scripts/build-liblouis-wasm.sh from
    https://github.com/liblouis/liblouis/releases/download/v3.39.0/liblouis-3.39.0.tar.gz
    sha256 629fa8cb0dfd9ad457c5bf47a42f0953b673e62c8ad6b1d03ddc4e2bd20008f1
  liblouis 3.39.0, compiled unmodified, configured with
  --enable-ucs4 --disable-shared --without-yaml, emcc 6.0.9:
  -O2 --no-entry -s STACK_SIZE=5242880 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1
  -s EXPORT_NAME=createLiblouis -s ENVIRONMENT=web,worker,node
  -s DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0 -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s INVOKE_RUN=0
  -s ASSERTIONS=0, exporting _lou_version, _lou_charSize, _lou_translate,
  _lou_backTranslateString, _lou_checkTable, _lou_free, _malloc, _free and
  the FS, HEAPU8, HEAPU32, HEAP32, UTF8ToString, stringToUTF8 and
  lengthBytesUTF8 runtime methods.

    liblouis.wasm  164567 bytes  sha256 4640d9919a36c2ecae458f0746a6c46bfcefaefc7c20382fed6f65679dba378e
    liblouis.js     69526 bytes  sha256 bb8d37c013e2259e09b9e948b130f38dd8f18fa7d32d3a7da0c29781715471ca

Tables (tables/, tables.json)
  The 478 table files of the official liblouis 3.39.0 Windows release
  (liblouis-3.39.0-win64.zip, share/liblouis/tables), the same files as the
  tarball above: the ones the forge ships compare byte for byte. tables.json
  records each file's SHA-256 and each table's include closure, generated by
  scripts/build_liblouis_tables_index.py.

License
  The liblouis library and its translation tables: GNU Lesser General Public
  License, version 2.1 or (at your option) any later version, as granted in
  the upstream README and in each table's header. The full text is beside
  this file as COPYING.LESSER.liblouis. None of the liblouis command line
  tools (GPL-3.0-or-later) is shipped.

Getting the source
  The tarball above is the complete corresponding source for the liblouis
  part of this build. Every release is also published at
  https://github.com/liblouis/liblouis/releases.
